policy.preparation: one atomic load and one ANALYZE; same DB corpus/GIN retained for all groups
policy.first: fresh adapter connection only; DB/OS caches not cleared
policy.timing: complete snapshot read including local psql transport and commit; not pure SQL latency
policy.memory: adapter RSS via OS polls; container cgroup charge includes cache; not DB RSS
policy.admission: same 100k/k10 fixture already verified; observed old oracle RSS <768MiB; no new intermediate profile
policy.cpu: DB container 2CPU; host adapter/control/observer outside that quota
